records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: One small next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks again for making time for our welcome call last week. I know a new tool can slip down the list in a busy week, so no pressure here.

When you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them -- so creating your first project is usually the easiest place to begin. Teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, including in bulk from a CSV file.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that came up since we spoke.

Best,
Priya
